## Overview

One documentation version: its authored pages, where the resolved Markdown goes and what it may read.

- **Kind:** Interface

## Declaration

```ts
interface DoqContentTarget
```

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name?` | `string` | Unique name, also the `@name` of cross-version API links. Optional for a single target (defaults to "current"). |
| `authoring` | `string` | Directory of authored pages and `_`-prefixed fragments, relative to the project. |
| `out` | `string` | Directory the resolved pages are written to (usually the Analog content directory). Never overwritten files you wrote. |
| `sourceRoots?` | `string[]` | Directories `::source` may read from. Without any, `::source` is refused. |
| `api?` | `string[]` | Directories generated by `doq-api` whose `.doq-api.json` supplies the symbol index for `[[api:Name]]`. |
| `sourceUrl?` | `string` | Link template for "View source", `http(s)://…` with `{path}` and optionally `{revision}` and `{lines}`. |
| `revision?` | `string` | Replaces `{revision}` in `sourceUrl`: a tag or commit. Never guessed. |
| `sourcePathPrefix?` | `string` | Prepended to the project-relative path in `{path}` (for a monorepo package directory). |
| `sourceLines?` | `string` | Replaces `{lines}` for a region or range. Default `#L{start}-L{end}`. |
